spans.s:
जोष n. (-षं) Happiness, felicity, pleasure, enjoyment, satisfaction.
 f.
(-षा) A woman: see जोषा; also जोषित्, जोषिता, &c.
 E. जुष् to delight,
affix भावे घञ् fem. affix टाप्.

. In happiness, delightedly at ease, &c.
 3. Well,
excellently.
 4. Excessively, beyond bounds.
 E. जुष् to please or be
pleased, affix अमु, संज्ञायां कन् ।

जोषिका f. (-का)
 1. A bud, a germ.
 2. A woman.
 E. जुष् to please, affix कन्.
and fem form; some copies have more accurately perhaps कोषिका.

जोषित् f. (-षित्) A woman.
 E. जुष् to delight, affix इति; also योषित,
जोषिता, &c.

जोषिता f. (-ता) A woman,
 E. जुष् to please, affix क्त; also योषित, योषिता, &c.
